structural_change: S81-SERDES 10-19 (S81.STA.OWN.7): the SerDes column as an lp.py LANDED parent (replaces the draft s81lk_serdes_col_e3, which could not gen: kind cluster + multiple_cts_roots needs an lp record). All glue moved into children (live flags, status CDC, TX face/relay rows); decoder tiles are direct children in 4 rck regions with 11 D4/E2 landings (+6 edges); TX lane enc -> 2 relay rows -> landing tx->ptx (+3 edges) -> PMA TX; rx/st output regs; PMA RX moved to the W half under dsyn, PMA TX to the E half under the TX lane drop; 518.4 x 3844.8 approved slot. lpk3 (LEAD2-S81/LINK 10-19): lpk2 failed PDN-0006 (PMA M4 PG fully under its own M5 OBS); PMA abstracts v1.1 expose PG as M5 stripes on the parent 5.4 um lattice with M5 OBS only between them, strapped M5->M6 like hard children (macros[].pg_layer M5).
